title: Concrete Base
description: Unilateral leg strength and full core work: Bulgarian lunges, hip thrust and planks

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate arched and rounded back, breathe

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide, toes pointing outward

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Back foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, lift the hips, squeeze the glutes

exercises.name: Reverse hyper on table
exercises.instructions: Belly on the edge, lift the legs behind you

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: On the forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace the abs

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs up, extend opposite arm/leg alternating

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch the feet

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, rise fully to sitting, touch the feet

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
